whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Davis The Gym,

I noticed your gym is located in a prime spot near Paras HMRI Hospital in Patna, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for instant membership inquiries and trial bookings.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/davisthegym

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team Davis The Gym, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Davis The Gym) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? [If checked]: Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your gym near Paras HMRI Hospital in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? [If not checked]: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback. Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
